**Subject:** Request for Work From Home Arrangement and Updated Offer Letter

Dear [Manager's/HR's Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing regarding my upcoming start at [Company Name]. First, I want to express my sincere enthusiasm for joining the team and the opportunity ahead.

I wanted to discuss one aspect of my arrangement before my start date. Upon reviewing the logistics of my commute, I have found that the distance to the office would be considerably significant — approximately [X miles/hours] each way — which presents a practical challenge for a daily in-office schedule.

With this in mind, I would like to respectfully request a **work-from-home arrangement**, either full-time or on a hybrid basis, if the role and team's needs permit. I am fully committed to meeting all performance expectations, maintaining clear communication, and being available during standard business hours. I am confident this arrangement would not impact the quality or consistency of my contributions.

Additionally, if this arrangement is approved, I kindly request an **updated offer letter** reflecting:
- The agreed-upon work-from-home or hybrid arrangement
- An updated commencement date, if applicable

Please let me know if you would like to schedule a call to discuss this further. I am happy to accommodate your preferred time. I appreciate your understanding and look forward to your response.

Warm regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

---
